cat.name: Alley Cat
cat.desc: Fast and vain. Pounce: leaps up to 3 tiles onto a monster for double damage.

dog.name: Scruffy Dog
dog.desc: Loyal and sturdy. Lick Wounds: heals you when you're under half HP.

budgie.name: Chatty Budgie
budgie.desc: Fragile, hard to hit, never stops talking. Squawk: stuns nearby monsters for 2 turns.

mouse.name: Scheming Mouse
mouse.desc: Cunning and cowardly. Dirty Trick: triple damage on a hurt monster. Runs away when hurt.
